title: Sealed Keep
core_verb: Fight enemies and press switches to unlock the route, then defeat the boss to open the exit.
fantasy: A hero descends into a sealed stone keep of a few linked rooms.
fail_state: Your hearts reach zero from enemy attacks or traps.
win_state: Defeat the keep boss, then reach the exit room which unlocks once the boss falls.

interaction_tags.meaning: Hostile that attacks the player; its health and the boss's must reach zero to open the exit.
Collectible that unlocks the boss door.
A reachable switch opens the guard-room route; activating it is required before reaching the boss door.
The exit room; reachable only after the boss is defeated, reaching it wins.

notes: The open adventure is sliced to one keep floor: collect the key, activate the route switch, clear the enemies, defeat the boss, then reach the exit. This slice has one key-gated door and no inventory progression.

assumptions: The core verb requires a route switch in addition to the key-gated boss door; both prerequisites remain in the bounded slice.

scene.description: A sealed stone keep of three linked chambers lit by torches: an entry with an iron key on a pedestal and a switch opening the guard-room route, a guard room, and a boss hall whose door opens only with the key. The exit glows gold beyond the boss. Rubble, banners and broken urns line the rooms; moderate density.
